verdict.rationale: Docs describe a full, scheduleable export (Settings > Full Export > Automated Full Export) that outputs Markdown with front matter and CSV collections, explicitly designed to be 'human- and machine-readable' and reusable in other apps or programmatically, satisfying the open-format export/leave story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that a full export actually contains 100% of data (attachments, backlinks, block references) and any real-world account of a user completing a full migration out.
